name: copy-editor
description: Copy Editor: a workshop tool for prose with AI editing passes, annotations and revisions

scripts.vendor: npm run assets:dirs && cp node_modules/htmx.org/dist/htmx.min.js app/static/js/htmx.min.js
scripts.build:css: npm run assets:dirs && tailwindcss -i frontend/app.css -o app/static/css/app.css --minify
scripts.build: npm run vendor && npm run build:css && npm run build:js
scripts.watch:css: npm run assets:dirs && tailwindcss -i frontend/app.css -o app/static/css/app.css --watch=always
